title: B/F/TAF in people with both HIV-1 and hepatitis B: outcomes from the ALLIANCE open-label extension phase.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Data on bictegravir/emtricitabine/tenofovir alafenamide (B/F/TAF) in people with both HIV-1 and HBV are limited, particularly for treatment-experienced people. METHODS: ALLIANCE was a randomized, double-blind, active-controlled, phase 3 study of B/F/TAF versus dolutegravir (DTG) + emtricitabine/tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (F/TDF) in treatment-naïve adults with HIV-1 RNA ≥ 500 copies/mL and HBV DNA ≥ 2000 IU/mL. Participants received continuous B/F/TAF through 144 weeks (≥ 96 weeks of blinded treatment plus 48-week optional open-label extension [OLE]) or switched to B/F/TAF after ≥ 96 weeks of DTG + F/TDF through 48 weeks of OLE. Here we report outcomes from the OLE. RESULTS: 121 participants were included in the continuous B/F/TAF group; 89 in the switch group. Median B/F/TAF exposure was 186.4 and 48 weeks, respectively. HIV-1 and HBV suppression rates (missing = excluded) were maintained in both groups (B/F/TAF Week 144: 99.0% and 80.2%; switch OLE Week 48: 95.4% and 86.6%, respectively). Both groups had improved alanine aminotransferase normalization. HBV envelope antigen loss and seroconversion occurred in 44.8% and 29.3%, respectively, of participants receiving continuous B/F/TAF (Week 144) and 17.0% and 12.8% in the switch group (OLE Week 48). HBV surface antigen loss and seroconversion occurred in 22.5% and 15.5% (continuous B/F/TAF), and 4.3% and 0% (switch group) of participants, respectively. One participant (continuous B/F/TAF) discontinued due to study drug-unrelated treatment-emergent adverse event. No treatment-emergent resistance was reported. CONCLUSION: B/F/TAF was effective in HIV-1 and HBV suppression and well tolerated in treatment-naïve individuals for ≤ 3 years and ≤ 1 year after switching from a TDF-based regimen. Trial registration ClinicalTrials.gov NCT03547908 (first registration 2018-05-24).

title_zh: HIV-1 和乙型肝炎患者的 B/F/TAF:ALLIANCE 开放标签扩展阶段的结果。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Data on bictegravir/emtricitabine/tenofovir alafenamide (B/F/TAF) in people with both HIV-1 and HBV are limited, particularly for treatment-experienced people. METHODS: ALLIANCE was a randomized, double-blind, active-controlled, phase 3 study of B/F/TAF versus dolutegravir (DTG) + emtricitabine/tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (F/TDF) in treatment-naïve adults with HIV-1 RNA ≥ 500 copies/mL and HBV DNA ≥ 2000 IU/mL. Participants received continuous B/F/TAF through 144 weeks (≥ 96 weeks of blinded treatment plus 48-week optional open-label extension [OLE]) or switched to B/F/TAF after ≥ 96 weeks of DTG + F/TDF through 48 weeks of OLE. Here we report outcomes from the OLE. RESULTS: 121 participants were included in the continuous B/F/TAF group; 89 in the switch group. Median B/F/TAF exposure was 186.4 and 48 weeks, respectively. HIV-1 and HBV suppression rates (missing = excluded) were maintained in both groups (B/F/TAF Week 144: 99.0% and 80.2%; switch OLE Week 48: 95.4% and 86.6%, respectively). Both groups had improved alanine aminotransferase normalization. HBV envelope antigen loss and seroconversion occurred in 44.8% and 29.3%, respectively, of participants receiving continuous B/F/TAF (Week 144) and 17.0% and 12.8% in the switch group (OLE Week 48). HBV surface antigen loss and seroconversion occurred in 22.5% and 15.5% (continuous B/F/TAF), and 4.3% and 0% (switch group) of participants, respectively. One participant (continuous B/F/TAF) discontinued due to study drug-unrelated treatment-emergent adverse event. No treatment-emergent resistance was reported. CONCLUSION: B/F/TAF was effective in HIV-1 and HBV suppression and well tolerated in treatment-naïve individuals for ≤ 3 years and ≤ 1 year after switching from a TDF-based regimen. Trial registration ClinicalTrials.gov NCT03547908 (first registration 2018-05-24).

title: High Rates of Advanced Chronic Liver Disease in Patients With Chronic Hepatitis D Virus Infection in Uzbekistan
abstract: ABSTRACT Background and Aims Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is endemic in Uzbekistan. Previous data showed a high prevalence of anti‐hepatitis D virus (HDV) antibodies in HBsAg‐positive individuals. Limited data are available on disease severity, treatment availability and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) prevalence in patients with chronic HDV infection in Uzbekistan. Methods The Scientific Research Institute of Virology (SRIoV) is the leading medical and scientific reference centre for viral hepatitis in Uzbekistan. In this retrospective study, epidemiological, clinical and laboratory data were collected and analysed from all HBsAg‐positive patients presenting to the SRIoV between June 2023 and May 2024. Data from HDV‐coinfected and HBV‐monoinfected patients were compared. Results Data of 1393 individual patients were included. HDV coinfection was more prevalent than HBV‐monoinfection (73.9% [ n = 1030/1393]) vs. 26.1% [ n = 363/1393]. HDV‐infected patients were significantly younger (41.9 vs. 45.4, p p n = 4/1030). Consecutively, HDV RNA was detectable in 78.9% (812/1023) of patients. Quantitative HDV RNA was independently associated with ALT elevation > upper limit of normal. The HCC detection rate was low in both patient groups due to insufficient screening measures (HDV: n = 7/1030, HBV: n = 11/363). Conclusions In this retrospective cohort of 1393 individual patients, HDV coinfection exceeds HBV monoinfection in prevalence and disease severity. Most HDV‐infected patients present with advanced liver disease and currently lack access to HDV‐directed therapy.

title: Programmable Nanobody‐Targeting Chimeras Enable Intracellular Viral Protein Degradation
abstract: ABSTRACT Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major global health challenge, largely because current antiviral therapies seldom achieve sustained clearance of the viral surface antigen (HBsAg), a central driver of immune tolerance and viral persistence. Here, we present a programmable, nanobody‐based targeted protein degradation platform, termed Nanobody‐Targeting Chimera (Nab‐TAC), designed for the intracellular clearance of HBV antigens. To systematically identify functional degradation modules, we developed a split‐luciferase complementation‐based quantitative screening platform that benchmarks degron motifs and proximity‐inducing effectors, enabling comprehensive ranking of proteasome‐ and lysosome‐targeting elements across diverse cellular contexts and subcellular compartments. By coupling phage display‐derived nanobodies and single‐chain variable fragments with these optimized degradation modules, we engineered a panel of Nab‐TAC constructs that efficiently degrade viral HBsAg in hepatocytes. Notably, the lead construct, E3‐FCGR3B, achieved robust intrahepatic antigen clearance and markedly reduced circulating HBsAg levels in an HBV hydrodynamic injection mouse model. Together, these findings establish Nab‐TAC as a modular and versatile platform for targeted antiviral protein degradation and highlight its potential as a therapeutic strategy toward a functional cure for chronic HBV infection.

title: Viral Hepatitis B in the Kyrgyz Republic: Epidemiological Trends and the Role of Vaccination (Literature Review)
abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major public health problem in the Kyrgyz Republic, contributing significantly to the burden of chronic liver diseases, including cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. The aim of this study was to assess the epidemiological trends of HBV infection and evaluate the impact of vaccination on disease patterns. A systematic review of scientific publications (2015–2023), WHO reports, and national regulatory documents was conducted. The results demonstrate that the introduction of neonatal vaccination has led to a substantial decline in acute HBV incidence and the near elimination of infection among children. However, a high prevalence of chronic HBV persists among adults, particularly in cohorts born before the implementation of universal immunization. Regional disparities in vaccination coverage and incomplete vaccination schedules were also identified. The current epidemiological pattern is characterized by a shift of the disease burden toward adult populations. Achieving WHO elimination targets by 2030 requires the expansion of adult vaccination programs, strengthening epidemiological surveillance, and the integration of vaccination and disease monitoring systems.

abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)感染仍然是吉尔吉斯共和国的一个主要公共卫生问题,严重加重慢性肝病的负担,包括肝硬化和肝细胞癌。本研究的目的是评估乙型肝炎病毒感染的流行病学趋势并评估疫苗接种对疾病模式的影响。对科学出版物(2015-2023)、世卫组织报告和国家监管文件进行了系统审查。结果表明,新生儿疫苗接种的引入导致急性乙型肝炎发病率大幅下降,儿童感染几乎消除。然而,成人中慢性乙型肝炎的患病率仍然很高,特别是在实施全民免疫接种之前出生的人群中。还发现了疫苗接种覆盖率的地区差异和不完整的疫苗接种计划。当前流行病学模式的特点是疾病负担向成年人群转移。到2030年实现世卫组织消除目标需要扩大成人疫苗接种规划、加强流行病学监测以及疫苗接种和疾病监测系统的整合。

title: Bridging Gaps in Hepatitis B Virus Prevention: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Knowledge, Attitudes and Preventive Practices in Ethiopia.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection continues to pose a significant global health challenge, with prevention efforts heavily dependent on individuals' knowledge, attitudes, and practices. Recognizing the critical role of comprehensive data in shaping policy, we sought to pool estimates from primary studies conducted across various regions of Ethiopia. METHODS: Full text studies published in English from December 31st 2010 to May 31st, 2025 were identified through searches in the PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, African Journals Online, Google Scholar, and Scopus databases using the medical subject headings and text words. The protocol was registered in the PROSPERO and the results were reported accordance with the PRISMA 2020. The heterogeneity was evaluated graphically and using statistical methods. Publication bias was assessed with a funnel plot and Egger's regression (significant at P ≤ 0.05). A random-effects meta-analysis was performed to calculate the pooled estimates. RESULTS: The search identified 980 records and 26 studies met the eligibility criteria and were included. The pooled prevalence of a good level of knowledge, favorable attitudes, and good prevention practices was 47.45% (95% confidence interval (CI) 36.53, 58.36), 50.48% (95% CI 38.65, 62.30), and 36.22% (95% CI 27.22, 45.23), respectively. In the subgroup analysis, a good level of knowledge among barbers was only 11.14% (95% CI 8.55-13.74). Being a rural resident (pooled odds ratio (pOR) = 2.25, 95% CI 1.39, 3.63), illiterate (pOR = 2.22, 95% CI 1.30, 3.76), having poor knowledge (pOR = 2.13, 95% CI 1.56, 2.91), and having unfavorable attitudes (pOR = 3.56, 95% CI 1.17, 10.81) were significantly associated with poor HBV prevention practices. CONCLUSIONS AND RECOMMENDATIONS: The results revealed elevated gaps in knowledge, attitudes, and practices related to the prevention of HBV infection. These results highlight the urgent need to strengthen public awareness campaigns, integrate HBV modules into adult literacy programs, and develop culturally sensitive communication strategies to counter cultural myths that hinder positive attitudes and practices toward HBV prevention and care, establish mobile clinics for rural communities, promote adult education programs for rural communities in local languages.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection prevention in Ethiopia, focusing on individuals' knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) as determinants of prevention efforts, with a central question on the pooled estimates of KAP levels and associated factors across Ethiopian regions [A1, A2].
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: This is a systematic review and meta-analysis with a registered protocol (PROSPERO) and PRISMA 2020 reporting, searching PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, African Journals Online, Google Scholar, and Scopus for English-language studies published from December 31, 2010, to May 31, 2025 [A3, A4]. Eligibility criteria included primary studies, and heterogeneity was assessed graphically and statistically; publication bias was evaluated using funnel plots and Egger's regression (P ≤ 0.05) [A5, A6]. A random-effects meta-analysis was performed to calculate pooled estimates [A7].
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The pooled prevalence of good knowledge, favorable attitudes, and good prevention practices was 47.45% (95% CI 36.53, 58.36), 50.48% (95% CI 38.65, 62.30), and 36.22% (95% CI 27.22, 45.23), respectively [A9]. Subgroup analysis showed notably low knowledge among barbers (11.14%, 95% CI 8.55-13.74) [A10]. Poor prevention practices were significantly associated with rural residence (pOR = 2.25, 95% CI 1.39, 3.63), illiteracy (pOR = 2.22, 95% CI 1.30, 3.76), poor knowledge (pOR = 2.13, 95% CI 1.56, 2.91), and unfavorable attitudes (pOR = 3.56, 95% CI 1.17, 10.81) [A11].
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review reports substantial heterogeneity in pooled estimates, as evaluated graphically and statistically, which may limit the precision of conclusions [A5]. The evidence does not report the inclusion of non-English studies or qualitative research to contextualize quantitative findings, nor does it address potential biases in primary study designs beyond publication bias assessment [A3, A6].
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review highlights the need for targeted interventions to address low HBV prevention knowledge and practices, particularly among rural residents, illiterate populations, and barbers, and to improve attitudes toward prevention [A11, A10]. It suggests strengthening public awareness campaigns, integrating HBV education into adult literacy programs, and developing culturally sensitive communication strategies to counter myths hindering prevention efforts [A13].

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis synthesizes evidence on Hepatitis B virus (HBV) prevention knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) in Ethiopia, pooling data from 26 studies published between 2010 and 2025. The pooled prevalence of good knowledge, favorable attitudes, and good prevention practices was 47.45%, 50.48%, and 36.22%, respectively, with barbers showing notably low knowledge (11.14%). Poor prevention practices were linked to rural residence, illiteracy, poor knowledge, and unfavorable attitudes. The review identifies significant heterogeneity and gaps in evidence, including limited inclusion of non-English studies and qualitative research. It emphasizes the urgent need for targeted public health interventions, such as culturally adapted awareness campaigns and adult literacy programs, to address identified gaps and improve HBV prevention outcomes.

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述考察了埃塞俄比亚的乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染预防情况,重点关注个人的知识、态度和实践 (KAP) 作为预防工作的决定因素,核心问题是埃塞俄比亚各地区 KAP 水平和相关因素的汇总估计值 [A1、A2]。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 这是一项系统综述和荟萃分析,采用注册方案 (PROSPERO) 和 PRISMA 2020 报告,搜索 PubMed、Embase、Web of Science、African Journals Online、Google Scholar 和 Scopus 来查找 2010 年 12 月 31 日至 2025 年 5 月 31 日发表的英语研究 [A3,A4]。资格标准包括初步研究,并以图形和统计方式评估异质性;使用漏斗图和 Egger 回归评估发表偏倚 (P ≤ 0.05) [A5,A6]。进行随机效应荟萃分析来计算汇总估计值 [A7]。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述报告了通过图形和统计评估得出的汇总估计值存在显着异质性,这可能会限制结论的精确度[A5]。证据没有报告纳入非英语研究或定性研究以将定量结果置于背景中,也没有解决发表偏倚评估之外的主要研究设计中的潜在偏倚[A3,A6]。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该审查强调需要采取有针对性的干预措施来解决乙肝预防知识和实践较低的问题,特别是农村居民、文盲人群和理发师,并改善对预防的态度[A11,A10]。它建议加强公众意识运动,将乙型肝炎教育纳入成人扫盲计划,并制定文化敏感的沟通策略,以消除阻碍预防工作的谣言[A13]。

title: Enhanced surveillance for hepatitis B and C: insights into clinical care after diagnosis
abstract: BACKGROUND: There are known gaps in care uptake for hepatitis B virus (HBV) and hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection, and public health surveillance represents an opportunity to support health service engagement for cases; however, specific data are lacking regarding follow-up after diagnosis. We assessed outcomes of a Victorian initiative to enhance data availability and to support linkage to care. METHODS: Notified cases of HBV and HCV within Victoria during 2023-2024 were analysed to determine post-diagnosis follow-up, including variation by demographics and setting, and reported reasons for lack of linkage to care. RESULTS: Information was available for two-thirds of cases. For HBV, 37.7% reported current treatment or management, while 53.6% reported referral or assessment in progress; for HCV, these proportions were 33.3% and 54.7%. Reasons for gaps included loss to follow-up, cost barriers, and misapplication of HBV treatment criteria. DISCUSSION: Cascade of care information can be effectively collected via public health surveillance, and these systems represent an opportunity to support prioritisation of public health follow-up.

title: Surveillance of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) patients using Protein Induced by Vitamin K (PIVKA-II): A cost-utility analysis for Hong Kong
abstract: BACKGROUND & AIMS: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a leading cause of cancer-related death in Hong Kong. Common risk factors include chronic hepatitis B (CHB) infection and/ or liver cirrhosis (LC). Routine HCC surveillance using ultrasound plus alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) for patients with these conditions is recommended, but many patients still face limited access to ultrasound. For these, biomarker-based surveillance using a combination of protein induced by vitamin K absence or antagonist-II (PIVKA-II) plus AFP could provide a valuable alternative. METHODS: This study compared the cost-utility of routine HCC surveillance using 'PIVKA-II + AFP' to the recommended standard-of-care in Hong Kong: surveillance using 'US + AFP'. A health economic model using a Markov-microsimulation framework was adapted using published local data and settings. The model was used to compare diagnostic outcomes, overall costs, quality-adjusted life years (QALYs), and cost-utility of the alternative HCC surveillance methods. RESULTS: Compared to the current recommended standard-of-care, the results suggested that HCC surveillance using 'PIVKA-II + AFP' could improve detection of HCC during early-stage disease by 4.6 percentage points, thus enabling access to more effective treatment options for some patients. It could also reduce false positive diagnoses by 7.2%, which could alleviate the need for costly confirmatory testing. Overall, PIVKA-II + AFP' was associated with a gain of 0.019 QALYs and cost savings of HK $ 4,144 per individual. The results were particularly favorable for non-cirrhotic CHB patients. CONCLUSIONS: HCC surveillance using 'PIVKA-II + AFP' could be a feasible option for patients with CHB and/ or LC who face limited access to ultrasound-based surveillance. The combination has the potential to improve early-stage HCC detection, facilitating timely intervention and improving both survival outcomes and patient quality of life.

Common risk factors include chronic hepatitis B (CHB) infection and/ or liver cirrhosis (LC). Routine HCC surveillance using ultrasound plus alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) for patients with these conditions is recommended, but many patients still face limited access to ultrasound. For these, biomarker-based surveillance using a combination of protein induced by vitamin K absence or antagonist-II (PIVKA-II) plus AFP could provide a valuable alternative. METHODS: This study compared the cost-utility of routine HCC surveillance using 'PIVKA-II + AFP' to the recommended standard-of-care in Hong Kong: surveillance using 'US + AFP'. A health economic model using a Markov-microsimulation framework was adapted using published local data and settings. The model was used to compare diagnostic outcomes, overall costs, quality-adjusted life years (QALYs), and cost-utility of the alternative HCC surveillance methods. RESULTS: Compared to the current recommended standard-of-care, the results suggested that HCC surveillance using 'PIVKA-II + AFP' could improve detection of HCC during early-stage disease by 4.6 percentage points, thus enabling access to more effective treatment options for some patients. It could also reduce false positive diagnoses by 7.2%, which could alleviate the need for costly confirmatory testing. Overall, PIVKA-II + AFP' was associated with a gain of 0.019 QALYs and cost savings of HK $ 4,144 per individual. The results were particularly favorable for non-cirrhotic CHB patients. CONCLUSIONS: HCC surveillance using 'PIVKA-II + AFP' could be a feasible option for patients with CHB and/ or LC who face limited access to ultrasound-based surveillance. The combination has the potential to improve early-stage HCC detection, facilitating timely intervention and improving both survival outcomes and patient quality of life.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a leading cause of cancer-related death in Hong Kong, with chronic hepatitis B infection and liver cirrhosis as common risk factors. Routine surveillance using ultrasound plus alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) is recommended but limited by access constraints.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This study compared the cost-utility of HCC surveillance using 'PIVKA-II + AFP' to the standard-of-care 'US + AFP' in Hong Kong. A health economic model using a Markov-microsimulation framework was adapted using published local data and settings.
analysis.methods: A Markov-microsimulation model was used to compare diagnostic outcomes, overall costs, quality-adjusted life years (QALYs), and cost-utility of 'PIVKA-II + AFP' versus 'US + AFP'. The model assessed early-stage detection rates, false positives, and economic impact per individual.
analysis.main_results: Surveillance using 'PIVKA-II + AFP' improved early-stage HCC detection by 4.6 percentage points and reduced false positives by 7.2%. It was associated with a gain of 0.019 QALYs and cost savings of HK $4,144 per individual, with particularly favorable results for non-cirrhotic chronic hepatitis B patients.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that 'PIVKA-II + AFP' could serve as a feasible alternative for patients with limited access to ultrasound, potentially improving early detection and patient outcomes. The novelty lies in demonstrating cost-effectiveness alongside diagnostic benefits in a local healthcare context.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that adopting 'PIVKA-II + AFP' surveillance could enhance HCC detection efficiency and reduce healthcare costs in Hong Kong, particularly for high-risk groups with restricted access to ultrasound.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is derived from a model-based analysis using published data, which may not fully capture real-world variability or long-term outcomes. The strength of evidence is moderate due to reliance on simulated data rather than prospective clinical trials.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the cost-utility of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) surveillance using 'PIVKA-II + AFP' compared to the standard 'US + AFP' in Hong Kong. Using a Markov-microsimulation model, the alternative strategy improved early-stage detection by 4.6%, reduced false positives by 7.2%, and achieved a gain of 0.019 QALYs at a cost saving of HK $4,144 per individual. The approach was particularly beneficial for non-cirrhotic chronic hepatitis B patients. The authors conclude that 'PIVKA-II + AFP' could be a feasible option for patients with limited access to ultrasound, potentially enhancing early detection and patient outcomes while reducing healthcare costs.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 肝细胞癌(HCC)是香港癌症相关死亡的主要原因,其中慢性乙型肝炎感染和肝硬化是常见危险因素。建议使用超声加甲胎蛋白 (AFP) 进行常规监测,但受到准入限制。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究将香港使用“PIVKA-II + AFP”的 HCC 监测与标准护理“US + AFP”进行了成本效益比较。使用马尔可夫微观模拟框架的健康经济模型是根据已发布的当地数据和设置进行调整的。
elements_zh.methods: 使用马尔可夫微观模拟模型来比较“PIVKA-II + AFP”与“US + AFP”的诊断结果、总体成本、质量调整生命年 (QALY) 和成本效用。该模型评估了早期检测率、误报率和每个人的经济影响。
elements_zh.main_results: 使用“PIVKA-II + AFP”进行监测将早期 HCC 检出率提高了 4.6 个百分点,并将误报率降低了 7.2%。每位患者的 QALY 提高了 0.019 倍,成本节省了 4,144 港元,对于非肝硬化慢性乙型肝炎患者的结果尤其有利。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,“PIVKA-II + AFP”可以作为超声检查机会有限的患者的可行替代方案,有可能改善早期检测和患者预后。新颖之处在于在当地医疗保健环境中展示成本效益以及诊断优势。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,采用“PIVKA-II + AFP”监测可以提高香港的肝癌检测效率并降低医疗成本,特别是对于超声检查机会有限的高危人群。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据来自使用已发布数据进行的基于模型的分析,该分析可能无法完全捕捉现实世界的变异性或长期结果。由于依赖模拟数据而不是前瞻性临床试验,证据强度中等。

abstract_zh: 背景与目的:肝细胞癌(HCC)是香港癌症相关死亡的主要原因。常见的危险因素包括慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 感染和/或肝硬化 (LC)。建议对患有这些疾病的患者使用超声加甲胎蛋白 (AFP) 进行常规 HCC 监测,但许多患者接受超声检查的机会仍然有限。对于这些情况,使用维生素 K 缺乏或拮抗剂 II (PIVKA-II) 诱导的蛋白质与 AFP 的组合进行基于生物标志物的监测可以提供一种有价值的替代方案。方法:本研究将使用“PIVKA-II + AFP”的常规 HCC 监测与香港推荐的护理标准:使用“US + AFP”的监测进行了成本效益比较。使用马尔可夫微观模拟框架的健康经济模型是根据已发布的当地数据和设置进行调整的。该模型用于比较替代 HCC 监测方法的诊断结果、总体成本、质量调整生命年 (QALY) 和成本效益。结果:与目前推荐的护理标准相比,结果表明使用“PIVKA-II + AFP”进行 HCC 监测可以将早期疾病期间 HCC 的检出率提高 4.6 个百分点,从而使一些患者能够获得更有效的治疗选择。它还可以将假阳性诊断减少 7.2%,从而减少对昂贵的确认性检测的需求。总体而言,PIVKA-II + AFP' 与每人 0.019 QALY 的增益和 4,144 港元的成本节省相关。结果对于非肝硬化慢性乙型肝炎患者尤其有利。结论:对于超声监测机会有限的 CHB 和/或 LC 患者,使用“PIVKA-II + AFP”进行 HCC 监测可能是一种可行的选择。该组合有可能改善早期 HCC 检测,促进及时干预并改善生存结果和患者生活质量。

title: Hepatitis B knowledge, attitudes and practices among health-care workers in Vanuatu, 2024.
abstract: Objective: The prevalence of chronic hepatitis B in Vanuatu is high, at approximately 9%. While immunization has been available for infants since 1989, subsets of the adult population remain susceptible, including health-care workers. Prior to a planned roll-out of hepatitis B vaccination for health-care workers, we conducted a knowledge, attitudes and practices survey to inform education programmes aimed at promoting vaccine uptake. Methods: Clinical and non-clinical health-care professionals at risk of occupational exposure to hepatitis B were invited to complete an online survey from April to June 2024. The survey sought information on hepatitis B knowledge (10 questions), attitudes (6 questions) and clinical practices (3 questions), as well as participant demographics. Participant knowledge scores were calculated and potential associations with demographic factors explored using Fisher's exact test. Results: Most of the 50 respondents were female (73%) and worked in either hospitals or the Ministry of Health (82%). Knowledge was high, with a median score of 9 (range: 3-10); 21 participants scored 100%. The proportion of incorrect responses was highest for questions related to treatment availability and transmission risks. We found no evidence of associations between demographic factors and knowledge scores. Most participants believed that hepatitis B vaccines were useful (88%) and prevention and control measures would protect them from infection (96%). Discussion: Our survey revealed high levels of knowledge and generally positive attitudes towards people with hepatitis B and infection control practices. While our respondents are unlikely to be representative of all health-care workers in Vanuatu, findings offer useful insights into specific knowledge gaps that could be addressed in planned health-care worker education sessions ahead of the vaccination roll-out.

abstract_zh: 目标:瓦努阿图慢性乙型肝炎的患病率很高,约为 9%。虽然自 1989 年以来婴儿就可以进行免疫接种,但部分成年人口仍然易感,其中包括卫生保健工作者。在计划向医护人员推出乙型肝炎疫苗接种之前,我们进行了一项知识、态度和做法调查,为旨在促进疫苗接种的教育计划提供信息。方法:邀请有乙型肝炎职业暴露风险的临床和非临床卫生保健专业人员于 2024 年 4 月至 6 月完成一项在线调查。该调查寻求乙型肝炎知识(10 个问题)、态度(6 个问题)和临床实践(3 个问题)以及参与者人口统计信息。计算参与者的知识分数,并使用费舍尔精确检验探索与人口统计因素的潜在关联。结果:50 名受访者中大多数是女性 (73%),并且在医院或卫生部工作 (82%)。知识水平较高,中位数为9分(范围:3-10);21名参与者得分为100%。对于与治疗可用性和传播风险相关的问题,错误回答的比例最高。我们没有发现人口因素与知识得分之间存在关联的证据。大多数参与者认为乙型肝炎疫苗有用(88%),并且预防和控制措施可以保护他们免受感染(96%)。讨论:我们的调查显示,人们对乙型肝炎患者和感染控制措施的了解水平较高,普遍持积极态度。虽然我们的受访者不太可能代表瓦努阿图的所有卫生保健工作者,但调查结果提供了有关具体知识差距的有用见解,这些差距可以在疫苗接种推出之前计划的卫生保健工作者教育课程中得到解决。

title: Droplet Digital PCR Measurement of HBV DNA in On-Treatment Chronic HBV Patients: Association With HCC Development and Outcomes.
abstract: Low-level residual viremia can be present in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients on nucleos(t)ide analogues (NUCs). Due to the detection limits of current HBV DNA assays, the association between residual viremia and HBV-related HCC has not been well studied. This study included NUC-treated HBV-related HCC patients with unquantifiable serum HBV DNA by the conventional Cobas-Taqman assay (< 20 IU/mL) at HCC diagnosis. The HCC patients were matched in a 1:1 ratio with NUC-treated non-HCC controls. Serum samples at the time of HCC diagnosis, 1 year before, and 2 years before diagnosis were retrospectively retrieved and tested for residual viremia by a validated high-sensitivity droplet digital polymerase chain reaction assay (lower limit of detection 1.6 IU/mL). Among 208 patients (104 HCC vs. 104 controls; mean age 63.1, 80.8% male, 54.3% cirrhosis), residual viremia within 2 years was observed in 82.7% of HCC patients and 49.0% of controls (p < 0.001), and was independently associated with HCC occurrence (OR 7.243, 95% CI 1.862-28.170, p = 0.004). In HCC patients, residual viremia was associated with histological microvascular invasion (44.4% vs. 9.1% in patients without residual viremia, p = 0.033) and lower probability of presenting with Barcelona Clinic Liver Cancer stage 0 HCC (OR 0.281, 95% CI 0.094-0.838, p = 0.023). After median follow-up for 7.2 years, residual viremia within 2 years before HCC diagnosis was independently associated with liver-related mortality (HR 4.472, 95% CI 1.212-16.504, p = 0.025). Residual viremia in NUC-treated CHB patients is associated with a higher risk of HCC development, more advanced tumour staging and poorer outcomes. High-sensitivity HBV DNA assays may be utilized for monitoring in NUC treatment.

title_zh: 治疗慢性 HBV 患者中 HBV DNA 的微滴数字 PCR 测量:与 HCC 发展和结果的关联。
source_body_en: Low-level residual viremia can be present in chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients on nucleos(t)ide analogues (NUCs). Due to the detection limits of current HBV DNA assays, the association between residual viremia and HBV-related HCC has not been well studied. This study included NUC-treated HBV-related HCC patients with unquantifiable serum HBV DNA by the conventional Cobas-Taqman assay (< 20 IU/mL) at HCC diagnosis. The HCC patients were matched in a 1:1 ratio with NUC-treated non-HCC controls. Serum samples at the time of HCC diagnosis, 1 year before, and 2 years before diagnosis were retrospectively retrieved and tested for residual viremia by a validated high-sensitivity droplet digital polymerase chain reaction assay (lower limit of detection 1.6 IU/mL). Among 208 patients (104 HCC vs. 104 controls; mean age 63.1, 80.8% male, 54.3% cirrhosis), residual viremia within 2 years was observed in 82.7% of HCC patients and 49.0% of controls (p < 0.001), and was independently associated with HCC occurrence (OR 7.243, 95% CI 1.862-28.170, p = 0.004). In HCC patients, residual viremia was associated with histological microvascular invasion (44.4% vs. 9.1% in patients without residual viremia, p = 0.033) and lower probability of presenting with Barcelona Clinic Liver Cancer stage 0 HCC (OR 0.281, 95% CI 0.094-0.838, p = 0.023). After median follow-up for 7.2 years, residual viremia within 2 years before HCC diagnosis was independently associated with liver-related mortality (HR 4.472, 95% CI 1.212-16.504, p = 0.025). Residual viremia in NUC-treated CHB patients is associated with a higher risk of HCC development, more advanced tumour staging and poorer outcomes. High-sensitivity HBV DNA assays may be utilized for monitoring in NUC treatment.

title: Shear wave elastography-based intrahepatic heterogeneity quantification predicts prognosis in patients with hepatitis B virus-related acutely decompensated cirrhosis
abstract: Abstract Purpose To quantify intrahepatic heterogeneity (IHH) across biomechanical and morphological dimensions using two-dimensional (2D) shear wave elastography (SWE) images, and integrate it into a multimodal model for predicting 5-year mortality in patients with hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related acutely decompensated cirrhosis (ADC). Methods This retrospective study included 239 patients with HBV-ADC, randomly allocated into a training (n = 144) and a validation cohort (n = 95). Baseline clinical data, 2D SWE images, mean elasticity values, and 5-year outcomes were collected. Unsupervised K-means clustering was applied to local radiomic features extracted from spatially co-registered SWE and gray-scale regions of 2D-SWE images to derive dual-modality IHH scores. Using the training cohort, a multimodal model was developed via multivariate Cox regression, integrating independent clinical predictors, mean SWE values, and dual-modality IHH and radiomic scores. Result In the validation cohort, both the SWE- and gray-scale-derived IHH scores demonstrated robust prognostic value for 5-year mortality, achieving time-dependent areas under the curve (AUCs) of 0.826 and 0.795, and concordance indices (C-indices) of 0.736 and 0.692, respectively. For the multimodal model, SHAP analysis identified these IHH scores as the most critical determinants for individual risk stratification. title: An Exploratory Cost‐Utility Analysis of Screening and Treating Immigrants in Canada for Hepatitis D
abstract: ABSTRACT Hepatitis D is common among immigrants in Canada, who account for approximately 23% of the population and tend to originate from high‐endemic countries. Mortality rates are notably high among those with chronic infections, and immigrants are less likely to engage in screening and treatment services. This paper aims to assess the cost‐utility of screening and treating Hepatitis D Virus (HDV)‐positive immigrants in Canada compared with a scenario in which no screening is conducted. This analysis takes a public‐payer perspective, uses a lifetime time horizon with a 1.5% annual discount rate, and expresses costs in 2023 Canadian dollars. A state‐transition model representing the natural progression of chronic hepatitis B and hepatitis D was developed in TreeAge Pro and mapped onto three interventions: screening and treatment with bulevirtide; screening and treatment with pegylated interferon alfa‐2a; and screening and treatment with both bulevirtide and pegylated interferon alfa‐2a. The analysis was conducted in accordance with the guidelines of Canada's Drug Agency. The incremental cost‐effectiveness ratio (ICER) was estimated for each intervention. Model sensitivity was performed using both univariate and probabilistic sensitivity analyses. All screening and treatment strategies resulted in a reduction in cases of decompensated cirrhosis, hepatocellular carcinoma and liver death, with combination therapy demonstrating the most favourable outcomes. Nevertheless, HDV screening and treatment with pegylated interferon alfa‐2a monotherapy was the only cost‐effective strategy (ICER: $23,177/QALY). While monotherapy with pegylated interferon alfa‐2a proved cost‐effective, combination therapy with bulevirtide is likely more clinically effective and may be cost‐effective if treatment costs decrease significantly.

abstract_zh: 摘要 丁型肝炎在加拿大移民中很常见,他们约占总人口的 23%,并且往往来自高流行国家。慢性感染者的死亡率特别高,而且移民参与筛查和治疗服务的可能性较小。本文旨在评估与不进行筛查的情况相比,在加拿大筛查和治疗丁型肝炎病毒 (HDV) 阳性移民的成本效益。该分析从公共付款人的角度出发,使用终身时间范围和 1.5% 的年度贴现率,并以 2023 年加元表示成本。TreeAge Pro 中开发了代表慢性乙型肝炎和丁型肝炎自然进展的状态转换模型,并映射到三种干预措施:筛查和布列韦肽治疗;聚乙二醇化干扰素α-2a的筛查和治疗;以及使用 bulevivirtide 和聚乙二醇化干扰素 α-2a 进行筛查和治疗。该分析是根据加拿大药物管理局的指导方针进行的。估算每次干预的增量成本效益比(ICER)。使用单变量和概率敏感性分析进行模型敏感性。所有筛查和治疗策略都减少了失代偿性肝硬化、肝细胞癌和肝死亡的病例,其中联合治疗显示出最有利的结果。尽管如此,HDV 筛查和聚乙二醇干扰素 α-2a 单药治疗是唯一具有成本效益的策略(ICER:23,177 美元/QALY)。虽然聚乙二醇化干扰素 α-2a 单一疗法被证明具有成本效益,但与布列韦肽联合治疗可能在临床上更有效,并且如果治疗成本显着降低,则可能具有成本效益。

title: PD-1 blockade unleashes local hepatitis B virus-related B cell response inhibiting hepatocellular carcinoma.
abstract: The prevailing notion is that effector T cell activation mediates anti-PD-1 efficacy in cancer. Here, we conducted a mechanistic study parallel to our phase 2 trial of perioperative anti-PD-1 therapy in patients with resectable recurrent hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) (NCT04615143) to study its mechanism of action. Late-recurrence patients present two distinct subtypes characterized by T cell or B cell dominant responses in the tumor microenvironment by dynamic single-cell multi-omics analysis. Clonal antibody repertoire analysis and spatially paired scRNA-seq/BCR-seq reveal somatic hypermutation promoting antibody binding against hepatitis B virus core antigen (HBcAg) within tumor tertiary lymphoid structures (TLSs) in these type B-late recurrence patients. Mechanistically, HBcAg is exported into the extracellular space, triggering local B cell and antibody responses and complement activation. In mice, these high-affinity HBcAg-reactive antibodies lead to complement-mediated antitumor activity with enhanced anti-PD-1 efficacy. Thus, we uncover enhanced anti-virus B cell immunity within the TLS as a mechanism to anti-PD-1 in HCC.

abstract_zh: 普遍的观点是效应 T 细胞激活介导癌症中的抗 PD-1 功效。在这里,我们进行了一项与可切除复发性肝细胞癌 (HCC) 患者围手术期抗 PD-1 治疗 (NCT04615143) 患者的 2 期试验平行的机制研究,以研究其作用机制。通过动态单细胞多组学分析,晚期复发患者呈现出两种不同的亚型,其特征是肿瘤微环境中 T 细胞或 B 细胞占主导地位的反应。克隆抗体库分析和空间配对的 scRNA-seq/BCR-seq 揭示了在这些 B 型晚期复发患者中,体细胞超突变促进肿瘤三级淋巴结构 (TLS) 内针对乙型肝炎病毒核心抗原 (HBcAg) 的抗体结合。从机制上讲,HBcAg 被输出到细胞外空间,触发局部 B 细胞和抗体反应以及补体激活。在小鼠中,这些高亲和力 HBcAg 反应性抗体可产生补体介导的抗肿瘤活性,并增强抗 PD-1 功效。因此,我们发现 TLS 内增强的抗病毒 B 细胞免疫是 HCC 中抗 PD-1 的机制。

title: Safety and efficacy of libevitug in patients with chronic hepatitis B and D virus coinfection: A single-center, open-label, phase IIa trial in China
abstract: Background: Chronic HBV and HDV coinfection represents the most severe form of viral hepatitis. This study aimed to assess the safety and efficacy of libevitug (HH-003), a novel human monoclonal antibody targeting the PreS1 domain of the HBV large envelope protein, in patients with chronic HBV and HDV coinfection. Methods: This single-center, open-label, proof-of-concept phase IIa clinical trial enrolled 9 participants who received i.v. infusion of 20 mg/kg libevitug every 2 weeks for 24 weeks, followed by a 24-week follow-up period. Results: At week 24, 8 participants (88.9%) exhibited a reduction in HDV RNA ≥1 log 10 from baseline, with 4 (44.4%) achieving undetectable levels. 7 participants (77.8%) achieved virological response (undetectable HDV RNA or ≥2 log 10 decline from baseline). Among the 5 participants with elevated baseline ALT, 3 (60.0%) achieved a combined virological and biochemical response (ALT normalization). At week 48, 6 participants (66.7%) maintained the virological response achieved at the end of treatment (week 24), with 3 (33.3%) maintaining undetectable HDV RNA levels. Among the 7 participants with quantifiable HBV DNA at baseline, 2 (28.6%) achieved undetectable HBV DNA or ≥1 log 10 reduction at week 24. Serum HBsAg levels remained unchanged throughout the study period. Treatment-emergent adverse events were reported in 8 participants (88.9%), with only 1 participant (11.1%) experiencing treatment-related adverse events. No grade 3 or serious adverse events were reported, and no discontinuations due to adverse events occurred. Conclusions: Libevitug demonstrated promising antiviral activity, achieving substantial HDV RNA reduction, a high rate of ALT normalization, and favorable safety and tolerability in participants with chronic HBV and HDV coinfection.

abstract_zh: 背景:慢性 HBV 和 HDV 合并感染是最严重的病毒性肝炎。本研究旨在评估 libevitug (HH-003)(一种针对 HBV 大包膜蛋白 PreS1 结构域的新型人单克隆抗体)在慢性 HBV 和 HDV 合并感染患者中的安全性和有效性。方法:这项单中心、开放标签、概念验证 IIa 期临床试验招募了 9 名接受静脉注射的参与者。每2周输注20 mg/kg libevitug,持续24周,然后是24周的随访期。结果:第 24 周时,8 名参与者 (88.9%) 的 HDV RNA 较基线降低≥1 log 10,其中 4 名参与者 (44.4%) 达到不可检测的水平。7 名参与者 (77.8%) 实现了病毒学应答(HDV RNA 检测不到或较基线下降≥2 log 10)。在基线 ALT 升高的 5 名参与者中,3 名 (60.0%) 实现了病毒学和生化综合反应(ALT 正常化)。在第 48 周,6 名参与者 (66.7%) 维持了治疗结束时(第 24 周)所达到的病毒学应答,其中 3 名参与者 (33.3%) 维持了不可检测的 HDV RNA 水平。在基线时具有可量化 HBV DNA 的 7 名参与者中,2 名 (28.6%) 在第 24 周时实现了检测不到 HBV DNA 或 ≥1 log 10 降低。在整个研究期间,血清 HBsAg 水平保持不变。8 名参与者 (88.9%) 报告了治疗引起的不良事件,只有 1 名参与者 (11.1%) 经历了与治疗相关的不良事件。未报告 3 级或严重不良事件,也未发生因不良事件而停药的情况。结论:Libevitug 在慢性 HBV 和 HDV 合并感染的参与者中表现出良好的抗病毒活性,可显着降低 HDV RNA,提高 ALT 正常化率,并具有良好的安全性和耐受性。

title: Tissue-based detection of macrophage-associated YAP1-positive material in human acute liver injury: an exploratory immunopathological biopsy series.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Yes-associated protein 1 (YAP1), a downstream effector of the Hippo pathway, is implicated in hepatocellular stress, ductular reaction, and tissue repair. Experimental studies suggest that injured YAP1-activated hepatocytes can be cleared by Kupffer-cell phagocytosis, but corresponding human biopsy evidence remains limited. METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed seven adults who underwent clinically indicated liver biopsy within 10 days of initial presentation or referral admission for acute liver injury. Liver biopsy sections were assessed by hematoxylin and eosin staining, periodic acid-Schiff-diastase staining, YAP1 immunohistochemistry, and double immunofluorescence for YAP1 and CD68. Macrophage-associated YAP1-positive structures were operationally defined as YAP1-positive signals located within or immediately adjacent to CD68-positive macrophages in portal or periportal areas. The definition was intended to capture spatial association and was not intended to prove intracellular phagocytosis, molecular co-expression, or endogenous YAP1 expression by macrophages. Associations with peak Model for End-Stage Liver Disease (MELD) score and days to alanine aminotransferase (ALT) normalization were evaluated as exploratory analyses. RESULTS: The median age was 52 years, and etiologies included autoimmune hepatitis, primary biliary cholangitis-autoimmune hepatitis overlap, drug-induced liver injury, acute hepatitis B, and idiopathic acute liver injury. Liver biopsy was performed at a median of 5 days (range, 2-10 days) after initial presentation or referral admission. A median of nine portal tracts and five macrophage-associated YAP1-positive structures were evaluated per biopsy, yielding a median YAP1/CD68-positive portal-tract index of 58.3%. ALT normalized after a median of 26 days. The index showed a nominal inverse association with days to ALT normalization (Spearman rho = -0.86, p = 0.014; Pearson r = -0.79, p = 0.034), whereas MELD score was not significantly associated with the index or recovery time. Leave-one-out analyses retained the inverse direction but showed unstable significance because of the very small sample size. CONCLUSIONS: In this small exploratory biopsy series, YAP1-positive material was observed in spatial association with CD68-positive macrophages in early human acute liver injury. The YAP1/CD68-positive portal-tract index showed a hypothesis-generating relationship with biochemical recovery but should not be interpreted as a validated prognostic marker or proof of macrophage-mediated phagocytosis. Larger, etiology-specific studies with standardized biopsy timing, lineage markers, multiplex immunofluorescence, high-resolution imaging, and digital pathology are warranted.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: YAP1 与肝细胞应激、导管反应和组织修复有关,但有关急性肝损伤中巨噬细胞相关 YAP1 阳性物质的相应人体活检证据仍然有限。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们回顾性分析了 7 名成人,他们在因急性肝损伤首次就诊或转诊入院后 10 天内接受了有临床指征的肝活检。
elements_zh.methods: 通过苏木精和伊红染色、高碘酸希夫淀粉酶染色、YAP1 免疫组织化学以及 YAP1 和 CD68 双重免疫荧光对肝活检切片进行评估。巨噬细胞相关的 YAP1 阳性结构在操作上被定义为位于门脉或门脉区域 CD68 阳性巨噬细胞内或紧邻 CD68 阳性巨噬细胞的 YAP1 阳性信号。作为探索性分析,评估了终末期肝病模型 (MELD) 评分峰值和丙氨酸转氨酶 (ALT) 正常化天数之间的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: 每次活检评估了 9 个汇管束和 5 个巨噬细胞相关 YAP1 阳性结构的中位数,得出中位 YAP1/CD68 阳性汇管束指数为 58.3%。该指数与 ALT 正常化天数呈名义负相关(Spearman rho = -0.86,p = 0.014;Pearson r = -0.79,p = 0.034),而 MELD 评分与指数或恢复时间没有显着相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在这个小型探索性活检系列中,在人类早期急性肝损伤中观察到 YAP1 阳性物质与 CD68 阳性巨噬细胞存在空间关联。YAP1/CD68 阳性汇管指数显示与生化恢复存在假设生成关系,但不应被解释为经过验证的预后标志物或巨噬细胞介导的吞噬作用的证据。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 有必要进行更大规模、针对病因的研究,包括标准化活检时间、谱系标记、多重免疫荧光、高分辨率成像和数字病理学,以进一步研究这种空间关联。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量非常小的限制,导致留一分析的显着性不稳定。由于该研究的探索性和缺乏标准化方案,证据强度较低。

title: Trends in the etiology of acute insult and underlying chronic liver disease in patients with acute-on-chronic liver failure: A retrospective study in Southwest China (2020–2023)
abstract: The etiology of acute insults and underlying chronic liver disease in acute-on-chronic liver failure has evolved in recent years. This study examined etiological patterns and trends from 2020 to 2023 in Southwest China. This study is a retrospective analysis that included 346 patients diagnosed with acute-on-chronic liver failure according to the Asian pacific association for the study of liver criteria at our hospital from 2020 to 2023. The etiology of acute insult and chronic liver disease and changing trends from 2020 to 2023 were analyzed. The top 5 etiologies of acute insult were spontaneous hepatitis B virus (HBV) reactivation (45.4%), HBV reactivation due to nucleot(s)ide analog withdrawal (16.2%), drug-induced liver injury (16.2%), unknown (6.1%), and alcoholic hepatitis (4.6%). The top 5 etiologies of chronic liver disease were chronic hepatitis B (53.2%), HBV-associated cirrhosis (22.00%), chronic hepatitis B plus alcoholic hepatitis (6.6%), HBV plus alcoholic hepatitis-associated cirrhosis (6.4%), and alcoholic hepatitis-associated cirrhosis (3.8%). From 2020 to 2023, the percentage of patients with viral hepatitis initially declined and then increased. The percentage of patients with alcoholic hepatitis showed a slight declining trend. The proportion of HBV-associated cirrhosis increased from 18.8% to 29.9%. The percentage of patients with chronic hepatitis B plus alcoholic hepatitis decreased from 11.8% to 2.6%, respectively. Viral hepatitis, especially chronic hepatitis B, remains the leading cause of acute insult and underlying chronic liver disease in Southwest China. These findings underscore the need for targeted HBV management strategies.

title_zh: 慢加急性肝衰竭患者急性损伤和潜在慢性肝病的病因学趋势:中国西南地区的回顾性研究(2020-2023年)
source_body_en: The etiology of acute insults and underlying chronic liver disease in acute-on-chronic liver failure has evolved in recent years. This study examined etiological patterns and trends from 2020 to 2023 in Southwest China. This study is a retrospective analysis that included 346 patients diagnosed with acute-on-chronic liver failure according to the Asian pacific association for the study of liver criteria at our hospital from 2020 to 2023. The etiology of acute insult and chronic liver disease and changing trends from 2020 to 2023 were analyzed. The top 5 etiologies of acute insult were spontaneous hepatitis B virus (HBV) reactivation (45.4%), HBV reactivation due to nucleot(s)ide analog withdrawal (16.2%), drug-induced liver injury (16.2%), unknown (6.1%), and alcoholic hepatitis (4.6%). The top 5 etiologies of chronic liver disease were chronic hepatitis B (53.2%), HBV-associated cirrhosis (22.00%), chronic hepatitis B plus alcoholic hepatitis (6.6%), HBV plus alcoholic hepatitis-associated cirrhosis (6.4%), and alcoholic hepatitis-associated cirrhosis (3.8%). From 2020 to 2023, the percentage of patients with viral hepatitis initially declined and then increased. The percentage of patients with alcoholic hepatitis showed a slight declining trend. The proportion of HBV-associated cirrhosis increased from 18.8% to 29.9%. The percentage of patients with chronic hepatitis B plus alcoholic hepatitis decreased from 11.8% to 2.6%, respectively. Viral hepatitis, especially chronic hepatitis B, remains the leading cause of acute insult and underlying chronic liver disease in Southwest China. These findings underscore the need for targeted HBV management strategies.
abstract_zh: 近年来,慢性肝衰竭急性损伤和潜在慢性肝病的病因学有所发展。本研究调查了 2020 年至 2023 年中国西南地区的病因模式和趋势。本研究为回顾性分析,纳入2020年至2023年在我院根据亚太肝病研究协会标准诊断为慢性肝衰竭的346例患者,分析2020年至2023年急性损伤和慢性肝病的病因及变化趋势。急性损伤的前5位病因是自发性乙型肝炎病毒(HBV)再激活(45.4%)、核苷类似物戒断引起的HBV再激活(16.2%)、药物性肝损伤(16.2%)、不明原因(6.1%)和酒精性肝炎(4.6%)。慢性肝病病因前5位依次为慢性乙型肝炎(53.2%)、乙型肝炎相关性肝硬化(22.00%)、慢性乙型肝炎合并酒精性肝炎(6.6%)、乙型肝炎合并酒精性肝炎相关性肝硬化(6.4%)、酒精性肝炎相关性肝硬化(3.8%)。2020年至2023年,病毒性肝炎患者比例先下降后上升。酒精性肝炎患者比例呈小幅下降趋势。HBV相关肝硬化的比例从18.8%上升至29.9%。慢性乙型肝炎加酒精性肝炎患者比例分别从11.8%下降至2.6%。病毒性肝炎,尤其是慢性乙型肝炎,仍然是中国西南地区急性损伤和潜在慢性肝病的主要原因。这些发现强调了有针对性的乙肝治疗策略的必要性。

title: Skrining HBSAG untuk Deteksi Dini Infeksi Hepatitis B pada Populasi Dewasa di Kelurahan Semanan
abstract: Hepatitis B remains a public health problem with the potential to cause chronic liver disease, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma. Early detection through community-based screening is essential to improve case identification and prevent transmission. This community service activity aimed to conduct HBsAg screening and provide education regarding hepatitis B among the community. A total of 155 participants were involved, with a mean age of 46.49 ± 10.29 years and an age range of 19–80 years. Most participants were female, accounting for 109 individuals (70.3%), while males accounted for 46 individuals (29.7%). Screening results showed that 153 participants (98.7%) were HBsAg negative and 2 participants (1.3%) were HBsAg positive. Gender-based distribution demonstrated that all positive cases were found among female participants. The low proportion of HBsAg-positive results indicates that most screened individuals did not have active hepatitis B infection. Nevertheless, the identification of positive cases highlights the importance of regular screening and health education as strategies for early detection, prevention of liver disease complications, and control of hepatitis B transmission within the community.

title: Optimizing Hepatitis B screening: A comparison of ELISA and rapid tests
abstract: Hepatitis B remains a major global public health problem, particularly in areas of high endemicity such as Madagascar, where prevalence exceeds 8%. Diagnosis relies primarily on the ELISA immunoenzymatic technique, which is recognized for its reliability but is not widely available in resource-limited laboratories. Rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs) offer a practical alternative, but their performance in this context has yet to be evaluated. This prospective descriptive and analytical study compared the performance of the Virucheck® rapid test and the Wantai Bio Pharm ELISA for the detection of hepatitis B virus surface antigen (HBsAg). The sample consisted of 74 serum samples from patients with sickle cell disease and subjects followed at the JRA University Hospital. The results showed a seroprevalence of 6.75% by TDR versus 9.45% by ELISA. The TDR had a sensitivity of 71.41% and a specificity of 100%, while the ELISA confirmed its superiority with sensitivities exceeding 95% and specificities close to 98%. Beyond technical performance, the study highlighted a predominantly young population, reflecting the significance of mother-to-child transmission, as well as a notable seroprevalence among young adults linked to risky sexual behaviors. These findings underscore the urgency of early and targeted screening, combined with a strengthened vaccination strategy. In conclusion, optimizing hepatitis B screening in Madagascar relies on the complementary use of rapid tests—suitable for community-based screening—and ELISA, which is essential for diagnostic confirmation and clinical follow-up. This approach represents a strategic pathway to reduce transmission, improve vaccination coverage, and strengthen the fight against hepatitis B in a context of high endemicity.

abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎仍然是一个主要的全球公共卫生问题,特别是在马达加斯加等高流行地区,其患病率超过 8%。诊断主要依靠 ELISA 免疫酶技术,该技术因其可靠性而得到认可,但在资源有限的实验室中并未广泛使用。快速诊断测试(RDT)提供了一种实用的替代方案,但其在这方面的性能尚未得到评估。这项前瞻性描述性和分析性研究比较了 Virucheck® 快速检测和万泰生物 Pharm ELISA 在检测乙型肝炎病毒表面抗原 (HBsAg) 方面的性能。该样本由来自镰状细胞病患者和 JRA 大学医院随访受试者的 74 份血清样本组成。结果显示,TDR 的血清阳性率为 6.75%,而 ELISA 的血清阳性率为 9.45%。TDR的敏感性为71.41%,特异性为100%,而ELISA证实了其优越性,敏感性超过95%,特异性接近98%。除了技术性能之外,该研究还强调了年轻人口占主导地位,反映了母婴传播的重要性,以及与危险性行为相关的年轻人中显着的血清流行率。这些发现强调了早期和有针对性的筛查以及强化疫苗接种策略的紧迫性。总之,马达加斯加优化乙型肝炎筛查依赖于快速检测(适合基于社区的筛查)和 ELISA 的互补使用,这对于诊断确认和临床随访至关重要。这种方法代表了在乙型肝炎高流行的情况下减少传播、提高疫苗接种覆盖率和加强乙型肝炎防治工作的战略途径。

title: Development of a Triplex TaqMan Real-Time PCR Assay for Simultaneous Detection of Duck Hepatitis B Virus, Duck Adenovirus Type 3, and Streptococcus gallolyticus subsp. pasteurianus
abstract: Duck hepatitis B virus (DHBV), Duck adenovirus 3 (DAdV-3) and Streptococcus gallolyticus subsp. pasteurianus (SGSP) are three distinct pathogens associated with infectious diseases in waterfowl. Clinical differentiation among these agents is often difficult due to overlapping signs, underscoring the need for accurate, rapid, and simultaneous diagnostic tools to support early detection and effective disease surveillance. In this study, we developed and validated a triplex TaqMan real-time quantitative PCR (qPCR) assay for the simultaneous detection and quantification of DHBV, DAdV-3, and SGSP. The assay indicated high analytical sensitivity, achieving detection limits of 10 copies/μL for each target, with all standard curves showing excellent linearity (R2 = 0.999). The evaluation of specificity showed that the triplex qPCR assay had high specificity for the three target pathogens, as it did not yield any cross-reactive signals with other pathogens examined. Intra-assay and inter-assay coefficients of variation for recombinant plasmid standards were consistently <2%, indicating high reproducibility. Meanwhile, the assay was employed to investigate the epidemiology of the three pathogens in ducks. The positive rates for DHBV, DAdV-3 and SGSP were 73.95% (159/215), 11.16% (24/215) and 37.21% (80/215), respectively. The co-infection rates were 5.58% (12/215) for DHBV and DAdV-3, 27.91% (60/215) for DHBV and SGSP, 2.33% (5/215) for DAdV-3 and SGSP, and 2.33% (5/215) for all three pathogens. In summary, this triplex qPCR assay displays excellent specificity, sensitivity and repeatability, which may serve as a reliable testing tool for routine clinical diagnosis, epidemiological monitoring and co-infection screening of the three target pathogens in locally sampled duck populations.

abstract_zh: 鸭乙型肝炎病毒 (DHBV)、鸭腺病毒 3 (DAdV-3) 和溶没食子链球菌亚种。巴氏杆菌 (SGSP) 是与水禽传染病相关的三种不同病原体。由于症状重叠,这些药物之间的临床区分通常很困难,这凸显了需要准确、快速和同步的诊断工具来支持早期检测和有效的疾病监测。在本研究中,我们开发并验证了三重 TaqMan 实时定量 PCR (qPCR) 测定法,用于同时检测和定量 DHBV、DAdV-3 和 SGSP。该测定显示出高分析灵敏度,每个目标的检测限达到 10 拷贝/μL,所有标准曲线均显示出出色的线性(R2 = 0.999)。特异性评估表明,三重 qPCR 检测对三种目标病原体具有高度特异性,因为它没有与其他检查的病原体产生任何交叉反应信号。重组质粒标准品的测定内和测定间变异系数始终<2%,表明高重现性。同时,采用该方法对鸭体内三种病原体的流行病学进行了调查。DHBV、DAdV-3和SGSP的阳性率分别为73.95%(159/215)、11.16%(24/215)和37.21%(80/215)。DHBV和DAdV-3的共感染率为5.58%(12/215),DHBV和SGSP的共感染率为27.91%(60/215),DAdV-3和SGSP的共感染率为2.33%(5/215),三种病原体的共感染率为2.33%(5/215)。总之,该三重 qPCR 检测显示出优异的特异性、敏感性和重复性,可作为当地采样鸭群中三种目标病原体的常规临床诊断、流行病学监测和共感染筛查的可靠检测工具。

title: Combined percutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation and ultrasound-guided phrenic nerve block for persistent hiccups: A case report.
abstract: RATIONALE: Persistent hiccups lasting more than 48 hours are rare but can markedly impair quality of life. Conventional therapies are often limited by transient efficacy, side effects, invasiveness, highlighting the need for safer and more effective options. PATIENT CONCERNS: A 62-year-old male with chronic hepatitis B, hypertension, type 2 diabetes, prior pulmonary tuberculosis, and gastrointestinal disorders presented with fever for 7 days and persistent hiccups for 4 days, occurring at a frequency of 40 to 50 times per minute. Symptoms significantly interfered with eating, sleeping, and daily activities. abstract_zh: 背景:持续呃逆超过48小时罕见,但可严重影响生活质量。常规治疗因效果短暂、副作用及侵入性等局限,亟需更安全有效的替代方案。患者情况:一名62岁男性,既往患有慢性乙型肝炎、高血压、2型糖尿病、肺结核及胃肠道疾病,入院时发热7天,持续呃逆4天,呃逆频率为每分钟40至50次。症状严重干扰进食、睡眠及日常活动。诊断:排除中枢神经系统及代谢性病因后,诊断为与肺部感染及胃肠功能障碍相关的持续呃逆。干预措施:首次超声引导下膈神经阻滞仅暂时缓解约4小时。随后采用每日膈神经阻滞联合每日两次经皮耳迷走神经刺激(aVNS)的综合治疗,持续3天。结局:至第7天呃逆完全消失,呃逆评估工具评分从9降至0,匹兹堡睡眠质量指数评分从16降至2。aVNS启动后,患者出院后随访1个月。随访期间未观察到持续呃逆复发、延迟并发症或与治疗相关的不良事件。经验教训:本病例提示,超声引导下膈神经阻滞联合aVNS可能为对常规治疗无效的持续呃逆提供一种微创、安全且有效的治疗选择。有待更大规模研究验证其疗效及长期结局。

title: Recent Progress in the Synthesis of Entecavir
abstract: Entecavir, as the most effective hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA polymerase inhibitor currently used in the clinical treatment of chronic hepatitis B, holds significant clinical value. This paper systematically reviews the latest research advances (2012–2025) in the total synthesis of entecavir. Based on the differences in synthetic strategies for constructing its core cyclopentane skeleton, existing synthetic routes are categorized into three types: Carbon ring construction strategies mediated by cycloaddition and ring‐closing metathesis, multi‐catalytic cascade and fully catalytic asymmetric synthesis strategies, and stereoselective epoxide transformation and tandem reaction strategies. This classification not only clearly presents the technical characteristics of different synthetic approaches but also provides an important reference for the development of carbocyclic nucleoside analogs.

This paper systematically reviews the latest research advances (2012–2025) in the total synthesis of entecavir. Based on the differences in synthetic strategies for constructing its core cyclopentane skeleton, existing synthetic routes are categorized into three types: Carbon ring construction strategies mediated by cycloaddition and ring‐closing metathesis, multi‐catalytic cascade and fully catalytic asymmetric synthesis strategies, and stereoselective epoxide transformation and tandem reaction strategies. This classification not only clearly presents the technical characteristics of different synthetic approaches but also provides an important reference for the development of carbocyclic nucleoside analogs.

title: Case Report: Primary Central Nervous System Lymphoma With "Wine Glass" Sign Presenting as Somnolence and Fatigue.
abstract: BACKGROUND Primary central nervous system lymphoma (PCNSL) is a rare and aggressive extranodal non-Hodgkin lymphoma with highly heterogeneous clinical and imaging manifestations. Its atypical manifestations often lead to critical differential diagnosis challenges, resulting in high rates of misdiagnosis and delayed diagnosis. CASE REPORT We report a case of PCNSL in a 55-year-old male patient. The patient was a chronic hepatitis B virus carrier, with a history of consumption of medicinal wine with unknown ingredients 1 month prior to onset. He presented with progressive somnolence and generalized fatigue as the core initial symptoms, accompanied by other non-focal neurological deficits, including fever, altered mental status and cognitive impairment. Brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) revealed abnormal signals around the third ventricle and midbrain aqueduct, with a rare "wine glass" sign. In contrast, multiple contrast-enhanced MRI scans showed no typical homogeneous enhancement signals. Tumor cells were found in the third cerebrospinal fluid analysis, and he was definitively diagnosed with PCNSL after stereotactic biopsy. The patient's symptoms improved following a single fraction of radiotherapy treatment. CONCLUSIONS The insidious onset and atypical features of PCNSL increase the risk of delaying diagnosis, which may negatively impact patient outcomes. Here, we present a case of PCNSL exhibiting atypical clinical manifestations and imaging findings, while differentiating it from other neurological disorders with overlapping features. It also highlights the critical value of serial cerebrospinal fluid cytology and early biopsy for timely diagnosis, providing a clinical reference for managing similar cases.

abstract_zh: 背景原发性中枢神经系统淋巴瘤(PCNSL)是一种罕见的侵袭性结外非霍奇金淋巴瘤,具有高度异质性的临床和影像学表现。其非典型表现常常导致关键的鉴别诊断挑战,导致误诊和延误诊断率很高。病例报告 我们报告一例 55 岁男性患者的 PCNSL 病例。患者为慢性乙型肝炎病毒携带者,发病前1个月有饮用不明成分药酒史。他以进行性嗜睡和全身疲劳为核心初始症状,并伴有其他非局灶性神经功能缺损,包括发烧、精神状态改变和认知障碍。脑部磁共振成像(MRI)显示第三脑室和中脑导水管周围存在异常信号,并有罕见的“酒杯”征。相反,多次对比增强 MRI 扫描未显示典型的均匀增强信号。第三次脑脊液分析发现肿瘤细胞,立体定向活检后确诊PCNSL。经过一次放射治疗后,患者的症状有所改善。结论 PCNSL 的起病隐匿和非典型特征增加了延误诊断的风险,这可能对患者的治疗结果产生负面影响。在此,我们介绍一例 PCNSL 病例,该病例表现出非典型的临床表现和影像学表现,同时将其与具有重叠特征的其他神经系统疾病区分开来。它还强调了连续脑脊液细胞学检查和早期活检对于及时诊断的关键价值,为处理类似病例提供临床参考。

title: Antiviral activity of novel chemical compound 0411, derived from FUBP1-IN-1 against hepatitis B virus by upregulation of DUSP5
abstract: Current first-line drugs rarely achieve functional curesfor chronic hepatitis B patients, which urges us to explore novel anti-HBV therapeutic strategies. In this study, we found that the novel chemical compound 0411, a derivative of the FUBP1 inhibitor, FUBPI-IN-1, significantly suppressed HBV transcription both in vitro and in vivo. Transcriptome sequencing demonstrated that 0411 treatment markedly upregulated the expression of the dual-specificity phosphatase 5 (DUSP5) gene, a crucial regulator of the MAPK pathway. Further functional studies illustrated that the antiviral activity of compound 0411 was dependent on DUSP5. Mechanismly, 0411 treatment in HepG2-NTCP cells enhances the deposition of active histone modifications on the promoter of DUSP5 significantly. In conclusion, our findings demonstrate the potential of 0411 as an effective agent against HBV transcription.

title: Novel HBx-interacting host cellular factors regulate dynamic nuclear and cytoplasmic localization of Hepatitis B virus X protein (HBx)
abstract: The hepatitis B virus (HBV) X protein (HBx) is a key player in viral transcription, replication, and HBV-associated hepatocarcinogenesis. Several novel HBx-interacting host cellular factors: DDX1, DDX3, MOV10 RNA helicases, INI1/hSNF5 chromatin-remodeling factor, Rad18 DNA repair enzyme, and CPSF6 cleavage factor were identified. DDX1, DDX3, and MOV10 colocalized with HBx in cytoplasmic foci or aggregates. In contrast, INI1/hSNF5 and CPSF6 relocalized with HBx in nuclear speckles, interchromatin granule clusters (IGCs), and/or PML-nuclear bodies. Rad18 sequestered HBx in the nucleoli. Importantly, DDX3, MOV10, and INI1/hSNF5 restricted HBV replication, whereas CPSF6 facilitated HBV replication. Furthermore, DDX1 enhanced HBx-mediated NF-κB transcription, whereas MOV10 and Rad18 inhibited it. Altogether, HBx-interacting host factors determine dynamic nuclear and cytoplasmic localization of HBx and regulate HBV replication and HBx-mediated transcription.

title_zh: 新型 HBx 相互作用宿主细胞因子调节乙型肝炎病毒 X 蛋白 (HBx) 的动态核和细胞质定位
source_body_en: The hepatitis B virus (HBV) X protein (HBx) is a key player in viral transcription, replication, and HBV-associated hepatocarcinogenesis. Several novel HBx-interacting host cellular factors: DDX1, DDX3, MOV10 RNA helicases, INI1/hSNF5 chromatin-remodeling factor, Rad18 DNA repair enzyme, and CPSF6 cleavage factor were identified. DDX1, DDX3, and MOV10 colocalized with HBx in cytoplasmic foci or aggregates. In contrast, INI1/hSNF5 and CPSF6 relocalized with HBx in nuclear speckles, interchromatin granule clusters (IGCs), and/or PML-nuclear bodies. Rad18 sequestered HBx in the nucleoli. Importantly, DDX3, MOV10, and INI1/hSNF5 restricted HBV replication, whereas CPSF6 facilitated HBV replication. Furthermore, DDX1 enhanced HBx-mediated NF-κB transcription, whereas MOV10 and Rad18 inhibited it. Altogether, HBx-interacting host factors determine dynamic nuclear and cytoplasmic localization of HBx and regulate HBV replication and HBx-mediated transcription.
abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) X 蛋白 (HBx) 在病毒转录、复制和 HBV 相关肝癌发生中发挥关键作用。鉴定了几种新的 HBx 相互作用宿主细胞因子:DDX1、DDX3、MOV10 RNA 解旋酶、INI1/hSNF5 染色质重塑因子、Rad18 DNA 修复酶和 CPSF6 裂解因子。DDX1、DDX3 和 MOV10 与 HBx 共定位于细胞质灶或聚集体中。相反,INI1/hSNF5 和 CPSF6 与 HBx 一起重新定位于核斑点、染色质间颗粒簇 (IGC) 和/或 PML 核体中。Rad18 将 HBx 隔离在核仁中。重要的是,DDX3、MOV10 和 INI1/hSNF5 限制 HBV 复制,而 CPSF6 促进 HBV 复制。此外,DDX1 增强 HBx 介导的 NF-κB 转录,而 MOV10 和 Rad18 抑制它。总而言之,HBx 相互作用的宿主因子决定 HBx 的动态核和细胞质定位,并调节 HBV 复制和 HBx 介导的转录。

title: Terapias en enfermedades inflamatorias intestinales en situaciones especiales: tuberculosis, infección por VIH, virus hepatitis B y paciente crítico
abstract: Introducción: La enfermedad inflamatoria intestinal (EII) en situaciones especiales constituye un desafío clínico. La inmunosupresión sostenida predispone a infecciones oportunistas y a la reactivación de infecciones latentes, mientras que determinadas comorbilidades condicionan decisiones terapéuticas que escapan a los protocolos convencionales. Objetivo: Revisar la evidencia disponible sobre el manejo de cuatro situaciones especiales en la EII: tuberculosis (TBC), infección por VIH, hepatitis B (VHB) y paciente crítico. Métodos: Revisión narrativa basada en búsqueda sistemática en PubMed, guías ECCO, GETECCU, ACG y GETAID, priorizando publicaciones de los últimos cinco años. Resultados: El tamizaje de TBC latente es obligatorio antes de iniciar cualquier biológico, con riesgo de reactivación hasta 20 veces mayor con anti-TNF. El VIH aumenta el riesgo de desarrollar EII (OR 2,68) y confiere un fenotipo menos agresivo, pero mayor riesgo de infecciones oportunistas; los biológicos son seguros con VIH con carga viral negativa. El VHB requiere tamizaje serológico universal y profilaxis antiviral obligatoria en pacientes HBsAg positivos. El paciente crítico con EII demanda manejo multidisciplinario con evaluación precoz del riesgo quirúrgico, soporte nutricional intensivo y consideración de terapias de rescate según disponibilidad y contraindicaciones. Conclusiones: El manejo de la EII en situaciones especiales requiere decisiones individualizadas, fundamentadas en la mejor evidencia disponible y en un abordaje multidisciplinario.

full_text: Abstract Purpose of Review Long-term nucleos (t)ide analogue (NAs) treatment is usually required to maintain viral suppression in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB), with raising concerns on the long-term safety of NA therapy. In this review, we comprehensively summarized the current evidence on the long-term safety of NA therapy, with a particular focus on the first-line NAs (entecavir [ETV], tenofovir disoproxil fumarate [TDF], and tenofovir alafenamide [TAF]). Recent Findings The first-line NAs have no (TDF, TAF) or very low (ETV) viral resistance rates in treatment-naïve patients. ETV is associated with birth defects in animal studies. TDF is associated with a small risk renal and bone toxicity, primarily in older and higher risk patients. TAF has favorable renal and bone safety as compared to TDF, while its impact on lipid metabolism warrants attention. Although extremely rare, severe lactic acidosis can occur during NA treatment. Summary Long-term therapy with NAs is generally very safe, with potential risk of birth defects with ETV based on animal studies, potential viral resistance with ETV (rare if treatment-naïve and significant if prior lamivudine exposure/resistance), potential renal and bone mineral density adverse effects with TDF, lipid metabolism dysfunction with TAF, and rare but potentially severe lactic acidosis. Similar content being viewed by others Data Availability No datasets were generated or analysed during the current study. full_text_sections.full_text: Abstract Purpose of Review Long-term nucleos (t)ide analogue (NAs) treatment is usually required to maintain viral suppression in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB), with raising concerns on the long-term safety of NA therapy. In this review, we comprehensively summarized the current evidence on the long-term safety of NA therapy, with a particular focus on the first-line NAs (entecavir [ETV], tenofovir disoproxil fumarate [TDF], and tenofovir alafenamide [TAF]). Recent Findings The first-line NAs have no (TDF, TAF) or very low (ETV) viral resistance rates in treatment-naïve patients. ETV is associated with birth defects in animal studies. TDF is associated with a small risk renal and bone toxicity, primarily in older and higher risk patients. TAF has favorable renal and bone safety as compared to TDF, while its impact on lipid metabolism warrants attention. Although extremely rare, severe lactic acidosis can occur during NA treatment. Summary Long-term therapy with NAs is generally very safe, with potential risk of birth defects with ETV based on animal studies, potential viral resistance with ETV (rare if treatment-naïve and significant if prior lamivudine exposure/resistance), potential renal and bone mineral density adverse effects with TDF, lipid metabolism dysfunction with TAF, and rare but potentially severe lactic acidosis. Similar content being viewed by others Data Availability No datasets were generated or analysed during the current study. abstract_zh: 摘要 目的 本综述探讨长期核苷(酯)类似物(NAs)治疗在慢性乙型肝炎(CHB)患者中的长期安全性问题,因该类患者通常需长期用药以维持病毒抑制。本综述全面总结了NAs长期安全性的现有证据,重点关注一线NAs(恩替卡韦[ETV]、替诺福韦二吡呋酯[TDF]和替诺福韦艾拉酚胺[TAF])。最新进展 一线NAs在初治患者中病毒耐药率极低(TDF、TAF无耐药,ETV耐药率极低)。数据可用性 本研究未生成或分析任何数据集。——欧洲肝脏研究协会。综述文章:HBV单一感染患者核苷(酯)类似物的长期安全性。核苷(酯)类似物用于慢性乙型肝炎的不良事件:系统性综述。口服核苷(酯)类似物用于慢性乙型肝炎患者的长期安全性:一项涉及53,500名受试者的队列研究。恩替卡韦或替诺福韦治疗人群HBV耐药风险的系统性综述与荟萃分析。ETV在动物研究中与出生缺陷相关。TDF与肾脏和骨骼毒性的小风险相关,主要见于年龄较大和高风险患者。与TDF相比,TAF在肾脏和骨骼安全性方面更有利,但其对脂质代谢的影响需引起关注。尽管极罕见,NAs治疗期间仍可能发生严重乳酸性酸中毒。总结 长期NAs治疗总体安全性良好,但基于动物研究,ETV可能存在出生缺陷风险;ETV在初治患者中病毒耐药风险极低,但在既往接受拉米夫定...

title: Safety assessment for hepatectomy in patients with hepatocellular carcinoma combined with hepatitis B-related cirrhosis: Expert consensus
abstract: In China, more than 80% of patients with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) have varying degrees of cirrhosis caused by hepatitis B virus infection. Unlike in Western countries, hepatectomy remains one of the main treatment options for patients with HCC and cirrhosis in China. The severity of cirrhosis varies considerably among individual patients with HCC. Although liver function may remain within the normal range during the compensated stage, progressive cirrhosis significantly reduces hepatic functional reserve and regenerative capacity. As a result, the incidence of postoperative complications and liver failure increases after hepatectomy. Therefore, hepatectomy that preserves as much liver parenchyma as possible is required to ensure surgical safety in patients with different degrees of cirrhosis. At present, the impact of different degrees of cirrhosis on the risk of posthepatectomy liver failure in patients with HCC is not fully understood. In addition, no consensus has been established regarding the optimal surgical approach for patients with HCC and varying severities of cirrhosis. This gap represents an important factor affecting the safety of hepatectomy. Reducing the incidence of postoperative liver failure and mortality in patients with HCC and cirrhosis remains an important issue that requires further investigation. The Chinese Chapter of the International Hepato-Pancreato-Biliary Association, Group of Liver Surgery of the Chinese Society of Surgery, invited leading domestic experts in hepatobiliary surgery and hepatology to discuss the role of cirrhosis severity in the safety assessment of hepatectomy for HCC and strategies to improve surgical safety. This consensus aims to assist hepatobiliary surgeons in making appropriate surgical decisions for patients with HCC and cirrhosis, and to improve surgical safety.

title_zh: 肝细胞癌合并乙型肝炎相关性肝硬化患者肝切除术的安全性评估:专家共识
source_body_en: In China, more than 80% of patients with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) have varying degrees of cirrhosis caused by hepatitis B virus infection. abstract_zh: 在我国,80%以上的肝细胞癌(HCC)患者因乙型肝炎病毒感染而出现不同程度的肝硬化。与西方国家不同,肝切除术仍然是中国肝癌和肝硬化患者的主要治疗选择之一。肝细胞癌患者的肝硬化严重程度差异很大。尽管在代偿阶段肝功能可能保持在正常范围内,但进行性肝硬化会显着降低肝功能储备和再生能力。因此,肝切除术后术后并发症和肝功能衰竭的发生率增加。因此,对于不同程度的肝硬化患者,需要尽可能保留肝实质的肝切除术以确保手术安全。目前,不同程度的肝硬化对HCC患者肝切除术后肝衰竭风险的影响尚不完全清楚。此外,对于 HCC 和不同严重程度的肝硬化患者的最佳手术方法尚未达成共识。这一差距是影响肝切除术安全性的重要因素。降低肝癌和肝硬化患者术后肝衰竭的发生率和死亡率仍然是需要进一步研究的重要问题。国际肝胰胆协会中国分会、中华外科学会肝脏外科学组邀请国内肝胆外科和肝病学领域顶尖专家,共同探讨肝硬化严重程度在肝癌肝切除安全性评估中的作用以及提高手术安全性的策略。该共识旨在协助肝胆外科医生对HCC合并肝硬化患者做出适当的手术决策,并提高手术安全性。

abstract: Methylophiopogonone A (MON-A), an anti-inflammatory constituent of Ophiopogon japonicus, demonstrates therapeutic potential for liver fibrosis in patients with chronic hepatitis B and SARS-CoV-2 infection. This study aimed to investigate its metabolic profile using liver microsomes and cryopreserved hepatocytes from humans and three preclinical species (rat, dog, and monkey). MON-A was incubated separately with each system, and the samples were analyzed by ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography coupled with quadrupole/Orbitrap high-resolution mass spectrometry (UHPLC-Orbitrap-HRMS) in positive electrospray ionization mode. Data were processed using Compound Discoverer software with mass defect filtering. Metabolite structures were characterized based on accurate mass and MS2 fragment ions. A total of 14 metabolites were identified. The primary metabolic pathways included hydroxylation, oxidative methylenedioxyphenyl (MDP) ring-opening, oxidation, and glucuronidation. M11 (a glucuronide conjugate) was the most abundant metabolite across all species. Additionally, four glutathione (GSH) conjugates were detected, indicating the formation of reactive metabolites, notably ortho-quinone and quinone methide species. The formation of quinone methide species revealed that C2-C3 double bond is essential for the metabolic activation of the A-ring. This systematic study clarifies the metabolic fate of MON-A, providing important insights into its biotransformation pathways and potential for reactive metabolite formation. The results establish a foundation for evaluating both the therapeutic efficacy and safety profile of this anti-inflammatory candidate during preclinical development.

abstract_zh: 甲基麦冬酮 A (MON-A) 是麦冬的一种抗炎成分,具有治疗慢性乙型肝炎和 SARS-CoV-2 感染患者肝纤维化的潜力。本研究旨在利用人类和三种临床前物种(大鼠、狗和猴子)的肝微粒体和冷冻保存的肝细胞来研究其代谢特征。MON-A 与每个系统分别孵育,并通过超高效液相色谱结合四极杆/Orbitrap 高分辨率质谱 (UHPLC-Orbitrap-HRMS) 在正电喷雾电离模式下对样品进行分析。使用具有质量缺陷过滤功能的Compound Discoverer 软件处理数据。根据精确质量和 MS2 碎片离子对代谢物结构进行表征。总共鉴定出 14 种代谢物。主要代谢途径包括羟基化、氧化亚甲基二氧苯基(MDP)开环、氧化和葡萄糖醛酸化。M11(一种葡萄糖醛酸结合物)是所有物种中最丰富的代谢物。此外,还检测到四种谷胱甘肽(GSH)缀合物,表明形成了反应性代谢物,特别是邻醌和醌甲基化物。醌甲基化物的形成表明C2-C3双键对于A环的代谢活化至关重要。这项系统研究阐明了 MON-A 的代谢命运,为其生物转化途径和反应性代谢物形成的潜力提供了重要见解。结果为评估这种抗炎候选药物在临床前开发过程中的治疗效果和安全性奠定了基础。

title: Itaconic acid alleviates acute hepatitis by reprogramming NK cell metabolism with mitochondrial dysfunction
abstract:
Background

Immunometabolism provides critical insights into the pathogenesis and treatment of inflammatory diseases. Itaconic acid (ITA), a key immunomodulatory metabolite derived from the tricarboxylic acid cycle, has been extensively characterized in macrophages; however, its direct effects on NK cells and NK cell-mediated liver pathology remain poorly defined.

Methods

Using SCENITH and Seahorse analyses, we assessed ITA's impact on NK cell metabolism via multi-omics, and investigated its underlying mechanisms. The therapeutic potential was then evaluated in a mouse model of poly (I:C)-induced liver injury.

Results

We show that ITA reprograms NK cell metabolism to suppress their proliferation and killing capacity, simultaneously suppressing oxidative phosphorylation while inducing a compensatory glycolytic shift. Multi-omics integration revealed that this metabolic shift corresponds with the upregulation of glycolytic gene networks and significant mitochondrial impairment, mechanistically linked to the inhibition of succinate dehydrogenase (SDH) activity and the downregulation of the NRF1/TFAM mitochondrial biogenesis pathway. ITA also damages mitochondria and impairs autophagic activity, resulting in accumulation of dysfunctional mitochondria in NK cells. All these alterations lead to profound suppression of NK cell proliferation and cytotoxic function. Administration of ITA in mice with poly (I:C) -induced liver injury substantially attenuated hepatic damage and suppressed over-inflammation in the liver. This protective effect was associated with inhibited hepatic infiltration and function of both NK and T cells.

Conclusion

Our findings extend the understanding of the immune regulation and metabolic reprogramming of ITA to NK cells, showing that ITA inhibits SDH activity to down-regulate mitochondrial biogenesis through NRF1/TFAM in NK cells with consequent limitation of cytotoxic function, suggesting the further therapeutic potential of ITA application in NK cells-mediated liver pathologies.

title_zh: 衣康酸通过重新编程线粒体功能障碍的 NK 细胞代谢来缓解急性肝炎
source_body_en:
Background

Immunometabolism provides critical insights into the pathogenesis and treatment of inflammatory diseases. Itaconic acid (ITA), a key immunomodulatory metabolite derived from the tricarboxylic acid cycle, has been extensively characterized in macrophages; however, its direct effects on NK cells and NK cell-mediated liver pathology remain poorly defined.

Methods

Using SCENITH and Seahorse analyses, we assessed ITA's impact on NK cell metabolism via multi-omics, and investigated its underlying mechanisms. The therapeutic potential was then evaluated in a mouse model of poly (I:C)-induced liver injury.

Results

We show that ITA reprograms NK cell metabolism to suppress their proliferation and killing capacity, simultaneously suppressing oxidative phosphorylation while inducing a compensatory glycolytic shift. Multi-omics integration revealed that this metabolic shift corresponds with the upregulation of glycolytic gene networks and significant mitochondrial impairment, mechanistically linked to the inhibition of succinate dehydrogenase (SDH) activity and the downregulation of the NRF1/TFAM mitochondrial biogenesis pathway. ITA also damages mitochondria and impairs autophagic activity, resulting in accumulation of dysfunctional mitochondria in NK cells. All these alterations lead to profound suppression of NK cell proliferation and cytotoxic function. Administration of ITA in mice with poly (I:C) -induced liver injury substantially attenuated hepatic damage and suppressed over-inflammation in the liver. This protective effect was associated with inhibited hepatic infiltration and function of both NK and T cells.

Conclusion

Our findings extend the understanding of the immune regulation and metabolic reprogramming of ITA to NK cells, showing that ITA inhibits SDH activity to down-regulate mitochondrial biogenesis through NRF1/TFAM in NK cells with consequent limitation of cytotoxic function, suggesting the further therapeutic potential of ITA application in NK cells-mediated liver pathologies.
abstract_zh:
背景

免疫代谢为炎症性疾病的发病机制和治疗提供了重要的见解。衣康酸 (ITA) 是一种源自三羧酸循环的关键免疫调节代谢物,已在巨噬细胞中得到广泛表征;然而,其对 NK 细胞和 NK 细胞介导的肝脏病理学的直接影响仍不清楚。

方法

使用 SCENITH 和 Seahorse 分析,我们通过多组学评估了 ITA 对 NK 细胞代谢的影响,并研究了其潜在机制。然后在多聚 (I:C) 诱导的肝损伤小鼠模型中评估其治疗潜力。

结果

我们表明,ITA 重新编程 NK 细胞代谢,抑制其增殖和杀伤能力,同时抑制氧化磷酸化,同时诱导补偿性糖酵解转变。多组学整合表明,这种代谢变化与糖酵解基因网络的上调和显着的线粒体损伤相对应,在机制上与琥珀酸脱氢酶(SDH)活性的抑制和 NRF1/TFAM 线粒体生物发生途径的下调有关。ITA 还会损害线粒体并损害自噬活性,导致 NK 细胞中功能失调的线粒体积聚。所有这些改变都会导致 NK 细胞增殖和细胞毒功能受到严重抑制。对患有聚(I:C)诱导的肝损伤的小鼠施用ITA可显着减轻肝损伤并抑制肝脏的过度炎症。这种保护作用与抑制 NK 和 T 细胞的肝脏浸润和功能有关。

结论

我们的研究结果扩展了对 ITA 对 NK 细胞的免疫调节和代谢重编程的理解,表明 ITA 抑制 SDH 活性,通过 NK 细胞中的 NRF1/TFAM 下调线粒体生物合成,从而限制细胞毒功能,这表明 ITA 在 NK 细胞介导的肝脏病理中的应用具有进一步的治疗潜力。
